name: EPIC 212270583
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 7.8 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,765 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.88 solar masses and 7.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,713 K at its surface.
